title: SYSTEMATIC CHARACTERIZATION OF THE EFFECTIVENESS OF ALIGNMENT IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR CATEGORICAL DECISIONS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking how well Large Language Models align with human ethical values and principles in medical triage scenarios. It specifically probes the models' decision-making using established ethical frameworks such as utilitarianism (QALY maximization) and prioritarianism (favoring the 'worst-off').
